title: Anyone who may change settings chooses which AI account each flow uses from Settings, instead of an env var on the Mac
description: The Owner wants every person using FlowWeb to have a page and a setting for every function. Which AI account a flow uses is set today only on the Owner's Mac: by FW_CLAUDE_AUTH or FW_CODEX_AUTH when fwd starts, or by the engine line in the flow's config.json. Add packages/daemon/src/overseer/ai.ts: writeFlowAi saves one of four accounts (claude_plan, anthropic_key, chatgpt_plan, openai_key) as { adapter, auth } in $FW_HOME/flows/<key>/ai.json (mode 600), and flowEngine prefers it over config.json, answering chosen: true. fwd serves POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/ai { account } to the CLI token and a paired browser session, and GET /v1/supervisor shows ai { adapter, auth, chosen } per flow. The site queues it as kind flow.ai (hosted/server/requests.mjs; migration 0007 allows the kind) and the relay applies it. Settings gets an AI for each flow section (packages/web/src/settings/AiSettings.tsx) listing each flow with the four accounts, the current one checked, a note when that account failed its last test, and the choices disabled for people who may not change them. Only the choice moves; keys stay in the machine's keychain. An env var given when fwd starts still wins on that machine.
acceptance: writeFlowAi saves only the four accounts, mode 600, and flowEngine prefers the saved choice with chosen: true
POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/ai works from a paired browser session; bad accounts answer 400, unknown flows 404, no session 401
GET /v1/supervisor shows each flow's ai { adapter, auth, chosen }
The site queues flow.ai with only the account, the relay calls the same route, and migration 0007 allows flow.ai and every earlier kind
Settings lists each flow with its account checked, sends only the picked account, flags a failed test, and disables the choice when the person may not change it
